summary: Iteration-20: tested the new VIP pick-up proposal flow and the client Arrival Check-In. Backend: 7/7 pytest pass in /app/backend/tests/test_pickup_arrived.py. Covered pickup/propose (403 for non-VIP, 400 ADDRESS_REQUIRED, 400 PICKUP_PENDING on duplicate, happy path persists {address,city,postal_code,country,lat,lng,time,note,status='proposed'} and notifies the requester), pickup/decline (keeps booking pending, pickup.status='declined', VIP notified, and VIP is allowed to re-propose), pickup/accept (booking becomes confirmed + pickup.status='accepted'), arrived (400 NOT_DATE_TIME outside the 2h window; inside the window it sets arrived_at, posts a vs_arrived notification visible via GET /api/notifications as the VIP, and is idempotent on the second call). Frontend (Playwright on preview URL): logged in as VIP (testuser) on /vip-bookings — pending incoming card exposes vs-pickup-propose-{id}, clicking opens vs-pickup-form-{id} with AddressPicker manual mode (address-manual-street/city), vs-pickup-time-{id} (prefilled with the date start), vs-pickup-note-{id}, and vs-pickup-send-{id}. After send, the card shows vs-pickup-status-{id} with 'Pick-up proposed · 99 Pickup Lane, London · Pick-up time 02:00 · "Ring the bell"'. Logged in as admin (requester) and verified vs-pickup-accept-{id} + vs-pickup-decline-{id} buttons on the My Requests card; clicking accept flipped the booking to Confirmed, replaced the status with 'Pick-up agreed', and rendered vs-pickup-directions-{id}. For arrival, mutated the seed booking to start at now+30min and status=confirmed; as the admin client, vs-arrived-{id} 'I've arrived' appeared, clicking it posted the API call, toast fired, and the button was replaced with vs-arrived-badge-{id} '📍 Arrived at 01:38 AM' — also visible to the VIP under the Confirmed tab, with 2 vs_arrived in-app notifications in GET /api/notifications. Existing vs-taxi-* testids still render on pending cards (6 found). No regressions observed.

issues: Minor: when the pickup is in state 'declined', VipPickupBlock still shows the status pill 'Pick-up declined' alongside the re-propose button, which is correct, but the status text and the propose CTA share the same sky-tinted panel — consider greying out the declined row to avoid confusing the VIP that a proposal is still outstanding.

critical_code_review_comments: vs_pickup_propose uses model_dump(exclude={'time'}) which keeps the raw unsanitised 'address' from the request before the re-override — safe because address is overridden on the next line, but note the 'note' field is sanitised only via the fallback. Confirmed: pickup['note'] correctly caps to 300 chars.

vs_arrived gating relies on _vs_start_dt/_vs_end_dt interpreting booking date/start/end as UTC — any locale assumption on the client side could feel off; today's test used UTC start so OK, but consider stamping tz-aware date strings on booking creation.

VipPickupBlock does not disable the re-propose button while a declined pickup is being replaced — if network is slow a user could double-submit; add disabled={busy} on the propose button (currently only the send/answer buttons are busy-guarded).
server.py still 5672 lines — longstanding refactor flag.
